test-worker-debug.js: Drives the V8 inspector's NodeWorker domain (attaching to worker threads); a browser worker exposes no inspector to connect to.
test-worker-heap-statistics.js: Its fixture waits for the inspector's NodeWorker.attachedToWorker event; a browser worker exposes no inspector.
test-worker-name.js: Its fixture reads the worker title from the inspector's NodeWorker.attachedToWorker event; a browser worker exposes no inspector.
test-worker-heap-snapshot.js: Needs a V8 heap snapshot of the worker thread; the browser gives JavaScript no heap snapshot API.
test-worker-exit-heapsnapshot.js: Needs v8.getHeapSnapshot(); the browser gives JavaScript no heap snapshot API.
test-worker-resource-limits.js: Needs V8 heap limits per thread and the worker's out-of-memory termination; a Web Worker's heap size can't be limited from JavaScript.
test-worker-nearheaplimit-deadlock.js: Needs V8 heap limits per thread and the worker's out-of-memory termination; a Web Worker's heap size can't be limited from JavaScript.
test-worker-dns-terminate-during-query.j: Runs a DNS server on a UDP socket; a browser can't open UDP sockets.
test-worker-http2-generic-streams-termin: Needs http2 over a JS stream (internalBinding('js_stream') feeding nghttp2), which OpenVessel doesn't provide.
test-worker-http2-stream-terminate.js: Needs http2 over a JS stream (internalBinding('js_stream') feeding nghttp2), which OpenVessel doesn't provide.
test-worker-terminate-http2-respond-with: Needs http2 over a JS stream (internalBinding('js_stream') feeding nghttp2), which OpenVessel doesn't provide.
